body.message:
Unfortunately, we are unable to arrange a viewing today, as the apartment is currently occupied by an in-house guest who is scheduled to check out on the 11th.

If the current guest does not extend their stay, we may be able to arrange a viewing after the check-out. However, at this stage, we are unable to confirm the viewing until we receive confirmation regarding the guest's departure.

Thank you for your understanding, and we will keep you updated accordingly.
